title: variantly.tools — choose the page structure
question: The Gate Board world is settled. Three structures for the homepage were dealt; lock one, steer, or re-roll. All three keep the I'm a human / I'm an agent fork and a real, draggable before/after of the Oak & Iron example.

options.label: Terminal + Board
options.thesis: The first screen is the tool working: npx variantly types itself on the left while the departures board on the right fills with Oak & Iron variants that flip to READY.
options.viewport: Top: wordmark + human/agent fork. Left half: a terminal running npx variantly with the check-in pass summary. Right half: the board, rows flipping SCHEDULED → WORKING → READY. Under both: the real before/after of Oak & Iron with the 1…N dock, draggable.
options.risk: Two animated panels compete for the first glance; the board has to win and the terminal stay quiet.

options.label: Check-in Desk
options.thesis: Scrolling is travelling: the page walks you through four counters in order (check-in, board, compare, keep), each one a working miniature of the real app.
materials: the real compare at the third counter
options.viewport: Fork and headline across the top; the first counter is the check-in pass itself with FROM / VIA / TO / VARIANTS filled for Oak & Iron and a yellow Generate that scrolls you to the board.
options.risk: A four-step tour delays the payoff (the compare) to the third screen; impatient visitors may not scroll.

options.label: Departures Hall
options.thesis: The page is a concourse board at gate scale: ten variants of Oak & Iron listed as departures, and the selected row opens into the live before/after like a gate opening.
options.viewport: A full-width dark board with a giant row per variant (V01 EDITORIAL READY …); the human/agent fork sits in the board header like a gate selector; the top row is expanded into the draggable before/after.
options.risk: The darkest of the three; flap theatre at this scale can tip into costume if the copy isn't plain.

regions.label: board header: wordmark · human / agent fork · clock
